title: Add Agricultural & Horticultural Animations

requirements.text: Add animated agricultural and horticultural visual elements to the HomePage hero section. Include CSS/Tailwind keyframe animations such as gently swaying wheat stalks or crops, floating leaves, growing plants, or soil particle effects rendered via SVG or canvas overlays to create a lush, nature-inspired atmosphere.

quotes: Add agricultural and horticultural animation stylish

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section on HomePage displays at least two distinct animated agricultural/horticultural elements (e.g., swaying crops, floating leaves).
Animations loop smoothly without jank or layout shift.
Animations are styled consistently with the existing green/earth-tone design system.

requirements.text: Add subtle animated decorative elements with an agricultural theme to the ProductCatalogPage and BusinessProfilePage — such as animated leaf dividers, sprouting plant borders, or drifting pollen particles — to reinforce the agro-horticulture brand identity throughout the site.

quotes: Add agricultural and horticultural animation stylish

acceptanceCriteria: ProductCatalogPage has at least one animated agricultural decorative element visible on load.
BusinessProfilePage has at least one animated horticultural decorative element (e.g., animated leaf border or growing vine accent).
Decorative animations do not obscure content or interfere with interactive elements.

requirements.text: Enhance the Footer with a subtle animated agricultural/horticultural accent — such as a scrolling field row illustration, animated seedling icons, or a gently waving grass/crop strip — to unify the visual theme across the full page.

quotes: Add agricultural and horticultural animation stylish

acceptanceCriteria: Footer includes at least one animated agricultural visual accent.
Animation is tasteful and does not distract from footer navigation links and contact information.

requirements.text: Define reusable Tailwind CSS keyframe animations (e.g., 'sway', 'float-up', 'leaf-drift', 'grow-in') in the Tailwind config to support all agricultural and horticultural animation effects across the site, ensuring consistent timing and easing.

quotes: Add agricultural and horticultural animation stylish

acceptanceCriteria: tailwind.config.js includes at least three new custom keyframe animation entries relevant to agricultural/horticultural motion.
New animation utility classes are used by the animated components in REQ-1, REQ-2, and REQ-3.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui/.
Animations must be performant (prefer CSS transforms and opacity over layout-affecting properties).
Do not alter backend logic or data models.
nonGoals: Changing the product catalog data or backend schema.
Replacing the existing color design tokens or overall layout structure.

required: Seamless horizontal strip illustration of stylized wheat stalks, sunflowers, and leafy vegetable plants in a flat vector art style with earthy greens and golden tones (agro-strip-banner.dim_1200x200.png)
Small decorative SVG-style leaf cluster icon with soft green gradient and subtle shadow (leaf-cluster-icon.dim_128x128.png)
Animated-ready seedling sprout illustration on transparent background with two small leaves and a soil mound (seedling-sprout.dim_256x256.png)
